# BeanHear

> BeanHear is an iOS story-reading app by WXH Labs for adult parents and caregivers with babies and young children approximately ages 0–5.

## Product facts
- Primary website: https://beanhear.com
- Support: support@wxhlabs.com
- Intended iOS flow: sign in, record approximately 20 seconds of your own adult voice (or an adult voice you are authorized to use), then unlock stories.
- Parent-voice narration is generated using a cloned voice; it is not a live parent reading.
- Stories are based on public-domain classics. No library size or title availability is promised here.
- The intended listening experience is hands-free on an iPhone or connected speaker, under caregiver supervision.
- Free includes 3 points. Points are not a promise of 3 stories.
- Premium pricing: US$7.99 per month or US$59.99 per year via Apple in-app purchase. Final local prices and subscription terms are shown in the iOS App Store purchase flow.
- BeanHear is an iOS app. Contact support@wxhlabs.com for availability. A real App Store / TestFlight listing URL is used if configured through APP_STORE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_STORE_URL. This landing page does not establish that the iOS app is publicly released.

## Website scope
- Day1 is a public landing website only.
- No logged-in web app, story player, voice upload, product API, Firebase integration, Stripe checkout, or web purchases are offered.
- The technical health endpoint /api/health returns { "ok": true, "product": "beanhear" }.
- Vercel Web Analytics is included for website traffic analytics.
- No users, downloads, testimonials, revenue, clinical benefits, or growth metrics are claimed.
